investments.name: Rations
investments.text: Hot meals before the horn — the wounded mend mid-raid and more of the fallen rise.

investments.name: Arrow Stockpile
investments.text: Bundled shafts for every bow — and better shot for every tower.

investments.name: Repair Wagons
investments.text: Crews roll out at dawn — damaged buildings are mended free after the raid.

investments.name: Reinforced Armor
investments.text: Fresh plate for the line — every defender shrugs off more.

investments.name: Frostwood Stakes
investments.text: Cold-hardened stakes slow the charge and blunt siege blows against walls.

warningLines: Horns on the night wind — riders under a pale moon. To the walls! They come in {count} heartbeats of {seconds}.
Dust on the border roads and a horn through the pines. {count} raiders, {seconds} breaths out. Light the lamps.
The watchfire gutters — hoofbeats past the treeline. {count} coming, {seconds} to bar the doors.
attackLines: They are over the fence! Wave {wave}, {count} strong — stand together!
victoryLines: The bell rings long — the Manner stands. {kills} fell, their pouches ours (+{loot} gold). Mend what broke.
Quiet again. {kills} raiders down, +{loot} gold in salvage. Oil the hinges and reset the traps.
defeatLines: The hall is ash and the bell is silent. Take the salvage wood and raise the beams again at dawn.
They broke the manor and melted into the trees. Salvage what you can — the village rises again.

enemyFactions.name: Thornband
enemyFactions.lore: Hungry woodland outlaws probe every unguarded road. Quick scouts fall easily to towers.

enemyFactions.name: Pale Host
enemyFactions.lore: Silent bowmen follow the mist. Close the distance before their arrows wear down the watch.

enemyFactions.name: Cinder Clan
enemyFactions.lore: Iron mauls hammer the gates. Slow breakers punish weak walls; layered defenses buy time.

enemyFactions.name: Ember Legion
enemyFactions.lore: The Cinder Clan's war-engine made flesh: rams for the gates, bombard-shells from afar. Kill the engines first.

enemyFactions.name: Pale Court
enemyFactions.lore: The Pale Host grown into a court: disciplined, gilded, merciless. Elites walk among them, and sometimes the Queen herself.

technologies.name: Moon orchards
technologies.text: Cultivate a dependable new food source.

technologies.name: Village medicine
technologies.text: Train the choir and establish a recovery bell.

technologies.name: Stone construction
technologies.text: Replace exposed timber with stone defenses.

technologies.name: Master engineering
technologies.text: Equip your builders for large projects.

technologies.name: Defensive fieldcraft
technologies.text: Prepare traps and better melee weapons.

technologies.name: Organized watch
technologies.text: Hold the perimeter with signal defenses and heavy weapons.

technologies.name: Runic forging
technologies.text: Improve the tools of smiths and armorers.

technologies.name: Metalworking
technologies.text: Recruit smelters to turn the workshop economy toward plate.

technologies.name: Education
technologies.text: Open a school and recruit apprentices.

technologies.name: Frontier commerce
technologies.text: Bring markets and specialist traders to town.

technologies.name: Deep woodcraft
technologies.text: Train specialists for the cold woods.

technologies.name: Waterway maps
technologies.text: Recruit divers and equip them for new expeditions.

hotspots.name: Stillwater
hotspots.text: The water is older than the Manor. Wren says the dark surface is honest: draw too hard from the land and even Stillwater will show the cost.

hotspots.name: Timber Line
hotspots.text: Old tax cuts still scar the boundary trees. Joren's tollmen are gone, but the line remains—a reminder that roads remember who charged for passage.

hotspots.name: Moonwell
hotspots.text: Moonstone dust shines in the mortar around the old well. The Mooncleric calls it borrowed light, never a miracle.

hotspots.name: Starwatch Ridge
hotspots.text: Sorrel's chalk marks survive on the high stones: horn counts, wind arrows, and the names of watchmen who stood here through nights too long to number.

hotspots.name: Whisperwood
hotspots.text: The pines carry sound farther than they should. Wayfinders leave paired cuts on safe trunks so travelers can tell an echo from a road.

hotspots.name: Ashfall March
hotspots.text: Charcoal lies under the grass in black seams. Failed hearths once stood here; Sarella says the ground remembers every fire that was asked to burn too long.

hotspots.name: Blackwater Mouth
hotspots.text: Broken pilings vanish beneath the black current. Fishers still tie a white thread to the first post before crossing, a habit nobody admits is a prayer.

hotspots.name: Southreach Crossing
hotspots.text: Four old roads meet under one weathered marker. The Pale Envoy chose this place because every road arrives owing something to another.

hotspots.name: Dawnfields
hotspots.text: The field earned its name from a single pale morning after the Longest Night. Nobody claims the sun returned; they only remember that the dark finally thinned.

hotspots.name: Pale Coast
hotspots.text: Salt crusts the ruined steps above the tide. Grey-market sailors leave copper nails in the cracks for luck and take nothing from the water after midnight.

frontierEvents.title: A Broken Axle at Southreach
frontierEvents.text: A Grey Road cart has thrown a wheel at the crossing. The driver has coin, but no timber worth trusting.

choices.label: Send 60 wood
choices.result: Your builders reset the axle before moonrise. The driver pays fair coin and carries your name down the road.

choices.label: Let the road handle it
choices.result: You leave the cart to the road crews. By morning only ruts and a broken spoke remain.

frontierEvents.title: Three Lights on Starwatch Ridge
frontierEvents.text: A watchman answers the Manor with three shielded lanterns: travelers below, weather turning, supplies running thin.

choices.label: Send 40 wood + 30 food
choices.result: The ridge stays manned through the bad weather. A grateful caravan leaves coin with the watch on its way through.

choices.label: Keep the ridge dark
choices.result: The lanterns go out one by one. The travelers find another road and the watch keeps its stores.

frontierEvents.title: Wayfinders in Whisperwood
frontierEvents.text: Two wayfinders have found an old safe trail but need provisions before they can mark it clearly enough for caravans.

choices.label: Send 50 food
choices.result: The paired cuts appear on the right trees by dawn. Traders use the safer trail and leave a road fee at the Manor.

choices.label: Leave the trail unmarked
choices.result: The wayfinders keep the route in their private charts. The woods stay quiet and difficult.

frontierEvents.title: A Boat at Blackwater Mouth
frontierEvents.text: A ferryman has grounded his flatboat on a split piling. He can save the cargo if the village sends straight timber.

choices.label: Send 55 wood
choices.result: The boat floats free before the tide turns. The ferryman leaves smoked fish and grain from the saved cargo.

choices.label: Wait for the tide
choices.result: The tide frees the hull hours later, but half the cargo has gone to the black water.

frontierEvents.title: Smoke under Ashfall March
frontierEvents.text: A buried charcoal hearth has begun breathing again under the turf. Sarella says it can be made safe, but not ignored cheaply.

choices.label: Send 70 wood + 40 food
choices.result: Crews cut a safe vent and brace the old pit. Salvaged fittings and charcoal sell well on the Grey Road.

choices.label: Mark it and move on
choices.result: The march is marked with white stones. Nobody camps there until the ground cools.

frontierEvents.title: Travelers in the Dawnfields
frontierEvents.text: A family caravan has stopped beside the old battle field. They ask for supper and offer tools cut from good northern timber.

choices.label: Send 65 food
choices.result: The travelers eat at your fire and trade a bundle of seasoned timber before taking the south road.

choices.label: Point them toward the road
choices.result: They thank the watch and move on before dark, keeping their stores for the long road.

frontierEvents.title: Salt from the Pale Coast
frontierEvents.text: A coast wagon offers preserved fish and salt at a steep road price before the tide road closes.

choices.label: Pay 70 gold
choices.result: The Manor stores fill with salt fish before the wagon turns inland. Winter meals will stretch farther.

choices.label: Keep the coin
choices.result: The wagon rolls north looking for another buyer. The salt smell lingers after the wheels are gone.

frontierEvents.title: Fresh Cuts in Whisperwood
frontierEvents.text: Tomm finds a fallen heartwood trunk across the paired-cut trail. The wardens can clear it before the next caravan, if the Manor sends supper.

choices.label: Send 50 food
choices.result: The wardens clear the fallen trunk without touching the living pines. A caravan pays its road fee at the Manor before dawn.

choices.label: Let the grove rest
choices.result: Tomm hangs a warning at the fork. The caravans take the longer road, and the grove keeps its quiet.

frontierEvents.title: A Thread above Blackwater
frontierEvents.text: The Mooncleric finds the first post leaning into the current. The mudlarks ask for straight timber to keep the white thread above the returning boats.

choices.label: Send 55 wood
choices.result: The mudlarks brace the post before the tide turns. Returning boats leave smoked fish at the Manor, and the white thread stays dry.

choices.label: Wait on the bank
choices.result: The Mooncleric lifts the thread to a safer branch. The boats take the far channel while the old post settles into the mud.

frontierCamps.name: Thornband Cut-Camp
frontierCamps.text: Fresh-cut stakes, hide tents, and a low cookfire sit under the pines. Thornband lookouts use this camp to watch the northern road.

frontierCamps.name: Pale Host Watch
frontierCamps.text: White cloth tied below the ridge marks a quiet roadside camp. Its fires stay low and every approach is carefully watched.

frontierCamps.name: Cinder Clan Road-Camp
frontierCamps.text: A heavy timber rack and a blackened firepit sit beside the old march road. The camp is built for long stays, not a single night.

frontierCamps.name: Ember Legion Works
frontierCamps.text: Red canvas shelters carts, timber frames, and stacked supplies. The site feels more like a field workshop than a temporary camp.

frontierCamps.name: Pale Court Shore Pavilion
frontierCamps.text: Pale banners stand in precise rows above the salt grass. Supplies are arranged by rank, giving the whole camp a ceremonial order.
